summary: Iteration 6 verification. Backend 17/17 pytest tests PASS (13 iter-5 regression + 4 new iter-6). BUG#1 reproducer passes: inserted category with legacy STRING subcategories directly via MongoClient; first GET normalized & PERSISTED shape (verified in DB); subsequent GETs return STABLE IDs; POST child with parent_id=<legacyA.id> returns 200 (NOT 'Parent subcategory not found'); parent_id chain preserved on subsequent GET. Default costume sort verified: GET /api/costumes with no sort returns identical order to sort=origin_year_desc (newest year first, nulls last). sort=origin_year_asc still ascending nulls-last. 3-deep nested Root→A→1 works. Frontend E2E on preview URL confirms: nav-inventory uses lucide-package svg (not shirt); /inventory title 'All Inventory' (0 occurrences of 'All Costumes'); default sort chip shows 'Most recently used'; sort SelectItems are exactly [Most recently used, Oldest first, Recently updated, Name A → Z, Total qty ↓] — no Origin year longform, no Sizing system; /inventory, /shows, /locations, /settings eyebrows are 'INVENTORY', 'SHOWS', 'LOCATIONS', 'SETTINGS' with NO 'INDEX NN /' prefix anywhere on the app; /shows year-sections (2026, 2025) use gap-6 grid with individual borders (no bg-[#E4E4E7] gap-px grey seam — visually confirmed via screenshot); dashboard has 'Most recently used' section title and uses /api/costumes?sort=origin_year_desc for its listing. Order in live UI: Black Trenchcoat (2026) first, Pirate Cumberbund (null) last — matches origin_year_desc with nulls-last.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py list_categories still auto-synthesizes ghost category docs from distinct costume.category values (lines 618-626). It now persists them (good), but the auto-insert on every read could race under concurrent requests. Consider guarding with a unique index on categories.name or checking DB-side.

server.py subcategory 'Parent subcategory not found' path (add_subcategory) now persists normalized subs BEFORE validating parent_id (line 670). This is idempotent and safe, but note: if the payload's parent_id is invalid, we've already done a write. Not a bug, just a minor side-effect worth documenting.

server.py list_costumes: default sort_spec is now [('origin_year', -1),('name', 1)] and Python-side post-sort applies nulls-last for both default and origin_year_desc (lines 353, 367-369). Fine, but the mongo-side sort is redundant — the Python re-sort overrides it. Consider removing mongo sort_spec when sort is None or origin_year_desc.
server.py update_show still does NOT validate name-year uniqueness on PUT — pre-existing issue from iter-5, unchanged.
server.py still uses deprecated @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') — migrate to lifespan (pre-existing).
Subcategory rename does NOT propagate to costume.subcategory strings (pre-existing carryover; documented in iter-5).
